electric.method: United Illuminating average price 35.4 cents/kWh (EIA-861 2025, revenue / sales, residential, bundled service (Part A)) x 259 kWh/month (3112 kWh/year): RECS 2020 microdata, Northeast (Middle Atlantic + New England) apartments in 5+ unit buildings whose main heat is not electric, 1 bedroom, weighted mean, n=165. Cross-check: published Table CE2.2 gives 4,650 kWh/year for all such apartments, electric heat included. Territory: point-in-polygon on HIFLD/ORNL Electric Retail Service Territories (2022 vintage), with documented overrides.
notes: CT town Derby: United Illuminating serves only 17 towns; override applied

if_heat_is_electric_add.note: RECS 2020 space-heating kWh in electrically heated Northeast apartments (5+ units), n=119; applies only if the tenant pays for electric heat. Not added to the amount.

cooking_only.method: Eversource CT gas (Yankee Gas), Rate 01 Residential Non-Heating Service: customer service charge $25.00 plus delivery charges totalling $2.5443 per Ccf (delivery 2.1255 + six riders); gas supply (PGA) is extra (summary last updated 2026-11-01); assumed cooking use 1.6 therms/month (RECS 2020 microdata, Northeast apartments in 5+ unit buildings with gas cooking, n=108). Taxes not included.

cooking_plus_heat.method: cooking-only figure ($29) + CT average residential gas price $1.632/therm (EIA 2024 annual, $16.83/Mcf at 1031 Btu per cubic foot) x 11.7 therms/month of space heating (annual use / 12; RECS 2020 microdata, Northeast apartments in 5+ unit buildings heated with gas, n=124). An annual average: winter bills are several times higher and summer bills lower. Water heating is not included.
